🟢 THE SUBSTITUTE THAT WORKS. The `cran` org read-only-mirrors every CRAN package, DESCRIPTION and all, so a CRAN grant is verifiable first-hand without CRAN. 🔴 But it answers name → package; it cannot answer capability → names. Verifies; cannot discover.

controls run this pass: catR 🟢 EXISTS · TAM 🟢 EXISTS · learnr 🟢 EXISTS · gradethis 🔴 ABSENT (genuinely not on CRAN) · qti 🔴 ABSENT (no such CRAN package) · zzzznotarealpackage 🔴 ABSENT (negative control). So ABSENT is informative, not merely uninformative: it separates "not on CRAN" from "does not exist".

🔵 p394 LOCALISES A CAUSE EARLIER CYCLES RECORDED AS "github-api-proxy-blocked". The body is explicit: *"GitHub access to this repository is not enabled for this session. Use add_repo to request access."* It is SESSION REPOSITORY SCOPING. That matters: it is not fixable by a retry, a header or another proxy route, and it WOULD be fixable by attaching a repo. Different remedy, so a different record.
